name: Wholefoods
description: Checks the week's Whole Foods discounts, plans seven days of meals around whatever is cheap, and hands back a shopping list sorted by aisle section. Built around one chain, so it is no use if you shop elsewhere or dislike letting promotions dictate dinner.

official.title: Wholefoods by Dennison
official.description: Weekly Whole Foods planner that pulls current store deals, builds a seven-day meal plan around what's on sale, and makes a categorized shopping list...
